entities.summary: Jakub Szela was a Polish leader of a peasant uprising against the Polish gentry in Galicia in 1846; directed against manorial property and oppression and rising against serfdom; scores of manors were attacked and their inhabitants murdered. Galician, mainly Polish, peasants killed ca. 1000 noblemen and destroyed ca. 500 manors in 1846.
